nodes.name: predict
nodes.description: Predict class label (0=malignant, 1=benign) for a 30-dim feature vector following the load_breast_cancer schema.

input_schema.features: array[30] of float (mean radius, mean texture, ... worst fractal dimension)

nodes.failure_boundary: Raises if features length != 30 or values outside training scale; returns class only, no confidence.

nodes.name: predict_proba
nodes.description: Return per-class probability for a 30-dim input vector.
nodes.failure_boundary: Same input constraints as predict; probabilities sum to 1.0, no calibration guarantee on out-of-distribution inputs.

nodes.name: explain
nodes.description: Return top-k features by XGBoost gain importance.

input_schema.top_k: int — number of features to return

output_schema.return: list — top-k feature names/indices by gain

nodes.failure_boundary: top_k > 30 clamps to 30; relies on frozen gain values from model.json, not recomputed.

nodes.name: classes
nodes.description: Return the list of class labels the model was trained on.
